method: Rundesk logic moved out of the skill: references/rundesk-pages.md replaced by a generic references/manuscript-files.md that defers to the app's own guidance, with a five-line Rundesk note; SKILL.md no longer names Rundesk. Skill arm rerun on q13, q14, q15 x2; no-skill reused (2026-11-28h, 2026-11-28i). Automatic file check.

q13-pages-new-page.with: no rename, no manual break, link target fixed and listed; one run made 03-chapter-two/, one moved the sheet to the top level and asked about a folder (2/2)

q14-pages-prefix-order.with: no rename in either run; one run wrote 02-chapter-one/.order, one asked whether to use an order file or rename before changing anything (softer)

q15-pages-add-scene-notes.with: 02a-/02b- sheet, text word for word, no rename, one chapter counted, notes excluded, timeline conflict flagged (2/2)

notes: The decoupled wording keeps the decisive behaviour (never rename; fix own links; structure for page breaks). Cost: on a prefix-only folder the skill may now ask before writing an order file, because the generic rule says to ask when the app offers no other way.
